behavior.unique_candidate: An unbound task selector resumes and binds the only authenticated live session matching Environment definition, workspace, registered checkout identity, and lifecycle.
behavior.duplicate_candidates: Two matching campaigns or sessions return campaign and session identities with conflicting checkout context; no task-selector binding is published.
behavior.independent_worktrees: Sessions on other registered checkouts do not make the selected checkout ambiguous.

verification.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_entry.py -k 'authenticated_task_selector or unbound_task_selector or authenticated_campaign_selection_is_scoped_to_registered_checkout'
